name: Data, analytics, API and infrastructure products
one_line: Sell what the venue does not serve free: archived books with on-chain-true direction, reconciled wallet records, cross-venue APIs, compliance feeds; nine vendors price at $9-$360/month, three exits in 2026, no disclosed revenue, and the ToS bars data distributors without a written agreement.
maturity: Established as a category (list prices, three 2026 acquisitions: Dome, Polymarket Analytics, Polynode; Kalshi-centred compliance contracts), unproven as income: no vendor discloses revenue, one closed to new subscribers; calibrated-probability feeds, no-code builders (users), bot-selling and independent vaults / funds have no revenue, user or TVL evidence
requires_ai: optional; LLMs for cross-venue market matching and rules extraction, not the paying product
edge: No official book history; feed direction ~59% right; correctness and coverage incumbents lack
capital: <$1k tracker; $1k-$10k dataset (recorder must run ~3 months first)
build_time: 2-4 weeks tracker; 4-8 weeks dataset product plus a recording quarter; 6-10 weeks compliance export
opportunity_size: No revenue disclosed; retail pool low tens of $k/month all vendors (guess); B2B growing, retail saturating
expected_results: no public data, theoretical only; guess -$80 to +$190 (tracker), -$400 to +$1,600 (dataset), $0 or $1-8k (one B2B contract) per month
competition: Nine priced vendors, free trackers and academic dumps, platform encroachment
flag: grey, near prohibited without agreement: ToS §4.2 bars data distributors and capital-market clients
validate: Written data-agreement query first; free tool + $9-29 pre-order (pass 20 in 30 days); dataset month sold to 2 of 4
top_risk: Platform ships the feature free, retires the API, or enforces §4.2
solo_fit_reason: Cheap to start, no market risk, and the recorder doubles as the backtest infrastructure the owner's own strategies need; but attention is scarce (median 2 HN points), free academic archives price history at zero, two incumbents already hold 10-14 months more book history, the venue keeps absorbing features, the ToS requires a written agreement for data distributors, and no independent vendor has shown revenue: a side business or an acquisition play rather than an income line.
speed_class: speed-insensitive; only the recorder is execution-sensitive (gaps are permanent)
results_1k: workable as free tool + $9 tier; -$80 to +$190/month (guess)
results_10k: -$1,000 to +$7,000/month; needs a data agreement and one B2B contract (guess)
min_capital: ~$2-3k; two recorders for three unpaid months
capacity_ceiling: Low tens of $k/month across all retail vendors; beyond that B2B or acquisition

open_doubts: No independent data vendor discloses revenue, subscribers or churn; every net figure in the size table is a guess.

Whether Telonex, Probalytics, PolymarketData or pmxt hold written data agreements with Polymarket is not public; if §4.2 is enforced against unlicensed 'market data distributors', the retail dataset sub-variant closes for anyone without one.
The compliance sub-variant's evidence is Kalshi-centred (Comply, StarCompliance, Nasdaq headline); Polymarket coverage is via ZenLedger and no Polymarket-side compliance contract is documented.
Both freshness readings of Data API v2 (0.8 s and 2.9 s) were idle-hour; the busy-hour 105-395 s lag from file 26 is a single window, and how often it recurs decides what a paid feed is worth.
Polynode's 'three to five seconds before onchain' is a vendor claim; its customer count and revenue are undisclosed.
ICE's signals product, the Eventual seed, Pascal's round and Kalshi's Nasdaq surveillance deal remain headline-only.
